get.description: Retrieves the agents in a department.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description:
Field used to search and list agents

Possible values: firstName, lastName, name, emailId

parameters.name: searchStr
parameters.description:
Search string used to match the first name, last name, or email ID

Note: - string* searches for values that start with the string - *string* searches for values that contain the string - string searches for exact matches - The string must contain at least one character

parameters.name: isLightAgent
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the returned agents must be light or non-light agents

Possible values: • true = returns light agents • false = returns non-light agents

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description:
Sort order used for the agents list

Possible values: asc, desc

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of agents to fetch

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which the agents must be listed

parameters.name: isConfirmed
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the returned agents must be confirmed or unconfirmed

Possible values: • true = returns confirmed agents • false = returns unconfirmed agents

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Activation status used to filter agents

Possible values: ACTIVE, DISABLED

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the department
